scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Reimbursement of CGTMSE Fees
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small, or Medium enterprise.
The enterprise must have availed a collateral-free term loan under CGTMSE.
The application must be submitted within one year from the date of first disbursement of the term loan, or on or before the commencement of commercial production, whichever is later.
benefits_summary: 100% reimbursement of annual service fees paid by entrepreneurs for up to 5 years.
